why: Both land on the key's hedgehog (most convenient drugstores, profit per customer visit, density) and the same brutal facts, but Analysis 1 commits to exiting food service on a firm five-year deadline and exiting the discount stores outright, whereas Analysis 2 only stops expansion and phases or tests the exit. Analysis 2 is somewhat better calibrated, with explicit falsification tests and flagged derived figures, but Analysis 1's sharper, more decisive verdict is the one I would hand to the leader.
